integrity.claim_scope: One theorem giving the pointwise dual degree, two exact defect factorizations, and the complete fixed-embedded-degree extremal classification.
integrity.computational_role: Exact regression over all factor pairs with product at most 5000 and a separate jet-class grid; no finite check substitutes for the proof.
integrity.source_date_note: The first-public date is the verified v1 submission timestamp of arXiv:math/0502500, 2005-02-23 UTC.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to complete Segre--Veronese embeddings \(\mathbb P^1\times\mathbb P^1\) by \(\mathcal O(a,b)\) with \(a,b\ge1\).
The originality conclusion is bounded by the inspected sources and searches; an equivalent fixed-degree envelope may exist under different terminology.
Finite enumeration is regression evidence only; the all-parameter claim rests on the Chern-class and monotonicity proof.
title: Sharp dual-degree defect factorizations for Segre--Veronese surfaces
